title: Liteparse
summary: Local OCR and text extraction for scanned, image-only or long PDFs, so you need not read pages as images.
details: For scanned, image-only or long PDFs, and many document photos, this skill extracts text locally with the lit CLI (installed via npm), so Claude searches a text file instead of reading every page as an image; it covers Armenian, Russian and English OCR. It is for anyone with scans, long PDFs or Armenian documents, and it never sends your files to a cloud OCR service without asking. It adds a skill folder plus a rule file, and it needs the lit and uv commands installed.
risk: Runs local scripts when used. No network except downloads it names.
